name: Kirsty Mackie
story: Women in Spatial + Survey’s committee biography describes Kirsty Mackie using GIS and remote sensing for geomorphometric analysis, then carrying GIS skills into photogrammetry and reality-capture work. The group records that she became its chair in 2023 and helped grow its Auckland branch.
Kirsty Mackie used GIS and remote sensing for geomorphometric analysis, then carried those skills into photogrammetry and reality-capture practice; she became WIS+S chair in 2023.
